scala-spiral.svg: the Scala spiral, cut UNALTERED (paths and colours as published) from the
full-colour Scala logo on Wikimedia Commons:
https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Scala-full-color.svg
Only the wordmark paths were dropped and the viewBox cropped to the spiral.

The Scala logo is a trademark of EPFL / the Scala Center. It is used on the film cover to name
the language the course teaches; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
`npm run thumb:film -- --mark glyph` builds the cover with the repo's own `=>` mark instead.
